newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Rexrodt says economy gaining pace.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Rexrodt says economy gaining pace.

text.p: German economics minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Tuesday the German economy had gained pace and the basic trend was upwards.

"We can confirm that the economy in the federal republic has regained pace...and all in all the basic tendency is once more upwards," Rexrodt told a news conference after a Franco-German economic summit here.
Rexrodt said: "We expect GDP growth of at least 0.75 percent this year, it could be higher or around one percent".
Rexrodt also said for 1997 Germany was in line to post economic growth of 2-2.5 percent.
